goals.title: Phase 0 — Workspace bootstrap
goals.objective: Initialize the gateway-control-panel monorepo: git, pnpm workspaces (apps/api + apps/web), TypeScript configs, ESLint + Prettier, Vitest + Playwright installed with one trivial passing test each, README skeleton (threat model incl. no-auth-on-LAN + foreground-command expectation, YAML schema, tab extension contract).
verification_steps: `pnpm install` succeeds
`pnpm typecheck` (or per-app equivalent) passes
`pnpm lint` passes (or no errors)
`pnpm -F api test` and `pnpm -F web test` show ≥1 trivial passing test each
`git status` shows initialized repo
goals.stop_condition: Workspace boots; both apps have package.json + tsconfig + at least one passing trivial test; README skeleton exists.

goals.title: Phase 1 — Backend skeleton + YAML authority
goals.objective: Build the Fastify backend with YAML as single source of truth: server.yaml loader (bind/port/polling cadence), gateways.yaml loader + atomic write + chokidar watch (250ms debounce), GET/PUT/POST/DELETE /api/gateways routes that round-trip through YAML, GET /api/health, plus integration tests for A1, A2, A3, F1, F3, R12, R13.
verification_steps: `pnpm -F api test:unit` and `pnpm -F api test:integration` pass
Atomic write-tmp + fsync + rename verified by injecting a failure mid-write
Chokidar reload verified by external `fs.writeFileSync` to the YAML
Default bind `127.0.0.1:8787` verified; `bind: 0.0.0.0` verified
No auth middleware registered (route inspection test)
EADDRINUSE surfaced verbatim when port is held
Missing `gateways.yaml` boots cleanly with empty list
goals.stop_condition: All listed AC tests pass; F1/F2/F3 integration tests pass; YAML authority model holds.

goals.title: Phase 2 — Process supervision + health probing + start/stop routes
goals.objective: Implement supervisor (spawn + PID capture; stopCommand execution; SIGTERM 5s grace then tree-kill; read-path process.kill(pid,0) authoritative liveness probe; per-id lock for R14), health probe module (scheduled HTTP GET, 2s timeout), POST /api/gateways/:id/{start,stop} routes, /api/gateways now merges YAML + supervisor + health. Tests cover C1, C2, C3 (incl. R11 bash-fork regression), G1, G2.
verification_steps: Foreground startCommand → PID captured within 3s, `process.kill(pid, 0)` succeeds
Stop → PID cleared within 5s, external `process.kill(pid, 0)` throws ESRCH
Bash-fork startCommand (`bash -c 'sleep 60 &'`) → card reports `running=false` (R11 regression)
Unreachable healthUrl → ok=false + error string within 2.5s
OK healthUrl → ok=true + HTTP code 200
Concurrent double-click Start → second returns HTTP 409
Concurrent double-click Stop on already-stopped → no-op
goals.stop_condition: All listed AC tests pass; R11 regression test passes; R14 lock test passes.

goals.title: Phase 3 — Frontend + tab system + gateways UI + e2e + final README
goals.objective: Build the Vite + React + TS SPA: api/client.ts typed wrappers + 3s polling, generic TabHost with registry (one stub tab + gateways tab), GatewaysTab + GatewayCard with start/stop/edit/add/delete, Vite dev proxy to backend, Playwright e2e smoke (H1) + A3/B1/B2/C1/C2/D UI tests + TabHost import-boundary unit test, README finalized (YAML schema documented; tab extension contract).
verification_steps: `pnpm -F web test:unit` and `pnpm -F web test:e2e` pass
TabHost import-boundary test: string-grep confirms zero `gateways` references in `TabHost.tsx`
Registry-extension test: two tabs (gateways + stub) registered without modifying `TabHost.tsx`
E2E: from clean clone, `pnpm install && pnpm dev` brings up panel with ≥2 sample gateways
E2E: external YAML edit appears on card within ≤1.5s
E2E: UI edit round-trips through YAML (file reflects change)
E2E: start/stop transitions happen within ≤5s
Vite dev proxy forwards `/api/*` to Fastify on `127.0.0.1:8787`
README documents threat model, YAML schema, tab extension contract
goals.stop_condition: All Phase 3 AC tests pass; README finalized; full A1–H1 coverage green.

final_gate.name: Final quality gate
steps: Architecture-invariant audit: TabHost does NOT import gateways; no-auth-in-MVP; default-bind preserved; YAML-as-authority preserved; tab-decoupling preserved
Final ledger checkpoint with cleaner + verification + review + invariant evidence
